lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm after a coffee that isn't too acidic. What would you recommend?
lines.ipa: /aɪm ˈaftəɹ ɐ kˈɒfi ðat ˌɪzənt tˈuː ɐsˈɪdɪk wˌɒt wʊd juː ɹˌɛkəmˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The house blend is gentler than the single-origin option on the board.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈaʊs blˈɛnd ɪz dʒˈɛntlə ðɐn ðə sˈɪŋɡəlˈɒɹɪdʒˌɪn ˈɒpʃən ɒnðə bˈɔːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could I try it without sugar first? I don't want sweetness to hide the flavour.
lines.ipa: /kʊd aɪ tɹˈaɪ ɪt wɪðˌaʊt ʃˈʊɡə fˈɜːst aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt swˈiːtnəs tə hˈaɪd ðə flˈeɪvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Certainly. If it isn't to your taste, tell me before I add the milk.
lines.ipa: /sˈɜːtənli ɪf ɪt ˌɪzənt tə jɔː tˈeɪst tˈɛl mˌiː bɪfˌɔːɹ aɪ ˈad ðə mˈɪlk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The menu calls this tea calming. Is that a flavour description or a health claim?
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈɛnjuː kˈɔːlz ðɪs tˈiː kˈɑːmɪŋ ɪz ðˌatə flˈeɪvə dɪskɹˈɪpʃən ɔːɹ ɐ hˈɛlθ klˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's meant to describe the blend, although I can see why the wording sounds stronger.
lines.ipa: /ɪts mˈɛnt tə dɪskɹˈaɪb ðə blˈɛnd ɔːlðˈəʊ aɪ kan sˈiː wˌaɪ ðə wˈɜːdɪŋ sˈaʊndz stɹˈɒŋɡə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd rather choose from the ingredients than from a promise like that.
lines.ipa: /aɪd ɹˈɑːðə tʃˈuːz fɹʌmðɪ ɪŋɡɹˈiːdiənts ðɐn fɹɒm ɐ pɹˈɒmɪs lˈaɪk ðˈat/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fair point. I'll bring the ingredient card and raise the wording with the owner.
lines.ipa: /fˈeə pˈɔɪnt aɪl bɹˈɪŋ ðɪ ɪŋɡɹˈiːdiənt kˈɑːd and ɹˈeɪz ðə wˈɜːdɪŋ wɪððɪ ˈəʊnə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't object to paying extra for plant milk. I object to discovering it afterwards.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt ɒbdʒˈɛkt tə pˈeɪɪŋ ˈɛkstɹə fɔː plˈant mˈɪlk aɪ ɒbdʒˈɛkt tə dɪskˈʌvəɹɪŋ ɪt ˈaftəwədz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We added the charge when our supplier increased the price.
lines.ipa: /wiː ˈadɪd ðə tʃˈɑːdʒ wɛn ˌaʊə səplˈaɪəɹ ɪŋkɹˈiːst ðə pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That explains the cost, but not why it was missing when I ordered.
lines.ipa: /ðat ɛksplˈeɪnz ðə kˈɒst bˌʌt nˌɒt wˌaɪ ɪt wɒz mˈɪsɪŋ wɛn aɪ ˈɔːdəd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're right. I'll correct this bill and make the charge visible at the counter.
lines.ipa: /jɔː ɹˈaɪt aɪl kəɹˈɛkt ðɪs bˈɪl and mˌeɪk ðə tʃˈɑːdʒ vˈɪzɪbəl at ðə kˈaʊntə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The refill discount is welcome, but you won't accept the cup I brought.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪfˈɪl dˈɪskaʊnt ɪz wˈɛlkʌm bˌʌt juː wəʊnt ɐksˈɛpt ðə kˈʌp aɪ bɹˈɔːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's wider than the space under the machine.
lines.ipa: /ɪts wˈaɪdə ðɐn ðə spˈeɪs ˌʌndə ðə məʃˈiːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you make the coffee in a jug and pour it into the cup?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː mˌeɪk ðə kˈɒfi ɪn ɐ dʒˈʌɡ and pˈɔːɹ ɪt ˌɪntʊ ðə kˈʌp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We can, as long as the cup is clean. That would avoid a disposable one.
lines.ipa: /wiː kˈan az lˈɒŋ az ðə kˈʌp ɪz klˈiːn ðat wʊd ɐvˈɔɪd ɐ dɪspˈəʊzəbəl wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your last slice of cake has been reserved for nearly an hour.
lines.ipa: /jɔː lˈast slˈaɪs ɒv kˈeɪk hˈazbiːn ɹɪzˈɜːvd fɔː nˌiəli ɐn ˈaʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The customer paid in advance and asked us to keep it.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈʌstəmə pˈeɪd ɪn ɐdvˈans and ˈaskt ˌʌs tə kˈiːp ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I assumed someone had simply put their name on it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɐsjˈuːmd sˈʌmwɒn had sˈɪmpli pˌʊt ðeə nˈeɪm ˈɒn ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I understand the question. We'll leave a paid reservation sign beside it.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn aɪ ˌʌndəstˈand ðə kwˈɛstʃən wiːl lˈiːv ɐ pˈeɪd ɹˌɛzəvˈeɪʃən sˈaɪn bɪsˈaɪd ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I asked for the drink to be remade, not for the first one to be poured into a new glass.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈaskt fəðə dɹˈɪŋk təbi ɹɪmˈeɪd nˌɒt fəðə fˈɜːst wˈɒn təbi pˈɔːd ˌɪntʊ ɐ njˈuː ɡlˈas/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm sorry. The person clearing the table misunderstood the request.
lines.ipa: /aɪm sˈɒɹi ðə pˈɜːsən klˈiəɹɪŋ ðə tˈeɪbəl mɪsˌʌndəstˈʊd ðə ɹɪkwˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you make sure the replacement actually uses the ingredients I ordered?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː mˌeɪk ʃˈʊə ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt ˈaktʃuːəli jˈuːsɪz ðɪ ɪŋɡɹˈiːdiənts aɪ ˈɔːdəd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll handle it myself and bring the order slip so we can check it.
lines.ipa: /aɪl hˈandəl ɪt maɪsˈɛlf and bɹˈɪŋ ðɪ ˈɔːdə slˈɪp sˌəʊ wiː kan tʃˈɛk ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This table is labelled laptop-free, but there are sockets under every seat.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs tˈeɪbəl ɪz lˈeɪbəld lˈaptɒpfɹˈiː bˌʌt ðeəɹˌɑː sˈɒkɪts ˌʌndəɹ ˈɛvɹɪ sˈiːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The sockets were installed before we introduced the lunchtime rule.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɒkɪts wɜːɹ ɪnstˈɔːld bɪfˌɔː wiː ˌɪntɹədjˈuːst ðə lˈʌntʃtaɪm ɹˈuːl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I chose it because my battery was nearly empty.
lines.ipa: /aɪ tʃˈəʊz ɪt bɪkˈɒz maɪ bˈatəɹi wɒz nˌiəli ˈɛmpti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can charge at the counter, though we need these tables free for people eating.
lines.ipa: /juː kan tʃˈɑːdʒ at ðə kˈaʊntə ðˌəʊ wiː nˈiːd ðiːz tˈeɪbəlz fɹˈiː fɔː pˈiːpəl ˈiːtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The bill includes a service charge. Does all of it go to the staff?
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈɪl ɪŋklˈuːdz ɐ sˈɜːvɪs tʃˈɑːdʒ dˈʌz ˈɔːl ɒv ɪt ɡˌəʊ tə ðə stˈaf/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It goes into a shared staff fund rather than to the person serving your table.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ɡəʊz ˌɪntʊ ɐ ʃˈeəd stˈaf fˈʌnd ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn tə ðə pˈɜːsən sˈɜːvɪŋ jɔː tˈeɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is it optional? The payment screen didn't make that clear.
lines.ipa: /ɪz ɪt ˈɒpʃənəl ðə pˈeɪmənt skɹˈiːn dˈɪdnt mˌeɪk ðat klˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. I'll show you the amount before you choose whether to include it.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪl ʃˈəʊ juː ðɪ ɐmˈaʊnt bɪfˌɔː juː tʃˈuːz wˈɛðə tʊ ɪŋklˈuːd ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We could guarantee eight people each week, but we can't promise a full meal order.
lines.ipa: /wiː kʊd ɡˌaɹəntˈiː ˈeɪt pˈiːpəl ˈiːtʃ wˈiːk bˌʌt wiː kˈɑːnt pɹˈɒmɪs ɐ fˈʊl mˈiːl ˈɔːdə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Our concern is keeping a large table occupied through the busiest hour.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə kənsˈɜːn ɪz kˈiːpɪŋ ɐ lˈɑːdʒ tˈeɪbəl ˈɒkjʊpˌaɪd θɹuː ðə bˈɪziɪst ˈaʊə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if we came after the lunch rush and agreed on a minimum drinks order?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt ɪf wiː kˈeɪm ˈaftə ðə lˈʌntʃ ɹˈʌʃ and ɐɡɹˈiːd ˌɒn ɐ mˈɪnɪməm dɹˈɪŋks ˈɔːdə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That would be easier to accommodate. Let's put the arrangement in writing.
lines.ipa: /ðat wʊd biː ˈiːziə tʊ ɐkˈɒmədˌeɪt lˈɛts pˌʊt ðɪ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt ɪn ɹˈaɪtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd like to leave feedback without naming the trainee who served us.
lines.ipa: /aɪd lˈaɪk tə lˈiːv fˈiːdbak wɪðˌaʊt nˈeɪmɪŋ ðə tɹˈeɪniː hˌuː sˈɜːvd ˌʌs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the problem with the service process rather than their behaviour?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə pɹˈɒbləm wɪððə sˈɜːvɪs pɹˈəʊsɛs ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ðeə bɪhˈeɪvjə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. They were handling two jobs and kept apologising for delays they couldn't control.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðeɪ wɜː hˈandlɪŋ tˈuː dʒˈɒbz and kˈɛpt ɐpˈɒlədʒˌaɪzɪŋ fɔː dɪlˈeɪz ðeɪ kˌʊdənt kəntɹˈəʊl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That distinction is useful. I'll record the staffing issue, not a complaint against one person.
lines.ipa: /ðat dɪstˈɪŋkʃən ɪz jˈuːsfəl aɪl ɹɪkˈɔːd ðə stˈafɪŋ ˈɪʃuː nˌɒtə kəmplˈeɪnt ɐɡˈɛnst wˈɒn pˈɜːsən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This fare is described as flexible, but every change seems to involve a fee.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs fˈeəɹ ɪz dɪskɹˈaɪbd az flˈɛksɪbəl bˌʌt ˈɛvɹɪ tʃˈeɪndʒ sˈiːmz tʊ ɪnvˈɒlv ɐ fˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The flexibility concerns the departure time; the route still has restrictions.
lines.ipa: /ðə flˌɛksəbˈɪlɪti kənsˈɜːnz ðə dɪpˈɑːtʃə tˈaɪm ðə ɹˈuːt stˈɪl hɐz ɹɪstɹˈɪkʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That isn't how most passengers would read the headline.
lines.ipa: /ðat ˌɪzənt hˌaʊ mˈəʊst pˈasɪndʒəz wʊd ɹˈiːd ðə hˈɛdlaɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I agree the summary should be clearer. Let's check whether your proposed journey is covered.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɐɡɹˈiː ðə sˈʌməɹi ʃˌʊd biː klˈiəɹə lˈɛts tʃˈɛk wˈɛðə jɔː pɹəpˈəʊzd dʒˈɜːni ɪz kˈʌvəd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The diversion sends passengers across a road with no pedestrian crossing.
lines.ipa: /ðə daɪvˈɜːʃən sˈɛndz pˈasɪndʒəz əkɹˌɒs ɐ ɹˈəʊd wɪð nˈəʊ pədˈɛstɹiən kɹˈɒsɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has the temporary stop been checked from both directions?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðə tˈɛmpɹəɹi stˈɒp bˌiːn tʃˈɛkt fɹɒm bˈəʊθ daɪɹˈɛkʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Apparently only from the station side.
lines.ipa: /ɐpˈaɹəntli ˈəʊnli fɹʌmðə stˈeɪʃən sˈaɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the signs alone won't fix it. We need a safe route for the return journey too.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə sˈaɪnz ɐlˈəʊn wəʊnt fˈɪks ɪt wiː nˈiːd ɐ sˈeɪf ɹˈuːt fəðə ɹɪtˈɜːn dʒˈɜːni tˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The airline offered a connection with only twenty-five minutes between flights.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈeəlaɪn ˈɒfəd ɐ kənˈɛkʃən wɪð ˈəʊnli twˈɛntifˈaɪv mˈɪnɪts bɪtwˌiːn flˈaɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did it account for changing terminals?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ɪt ɐkˈaʊnt fɔː tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ tˈɜːmɪnəlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The confirmation treats it as one journey, so I assumed it did.
lines.ipa: /ðə kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən tɹˈiːts ɪt az wˈɒn dʒˈɜːni sˌəʊ aɪ ɐsjˈuːmd ɪt dˈɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask them to confirm the transfer in writing rather than rely on the booking screen.
lines.ipa: /ˈask ðˌɛm tə kənfˈɜːm ðə tɹˈansfɜːɹ ɪn ɹˈaɪtɪŋ ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɹɪlˈaɪ ɒnðə bˈʊkɪŋ skɹˈiːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The luggage desk wants receipts for things I bought years ago.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈʌɡɪdʒ dˈɛsk wˈɒnts ɹɪsˈiːts fɔː θˈɪŋz aɪ bˈɔːt jˈiəz ɐɡˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can they accept photographs or other evidence of ownership?
lines.ipa: /kan ðeɪ ɐksˈɛpt fˈəʊtəɡɹˌafz ɔːɹ ˈʌðəɹ ˈɛvɪdəns ɒv ˈəʊnəʃˌɪp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They haven't said. The form only allows a receipt upload.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ hˈavənt sˈɛd ðə fˈɔːm ˈəʊnli ɐlˈaʊz ɐ ɹɪsˈiːt ˈʌpləʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Explain which documents you have and ask how unsupported items should be recorded.
lines.ipa: /ɛksplˈeɪn wˌɪtʃ dˈɒkjuːmənts juː hav and ˈask hˌaʊ ʌnsəpˈɔːtɪd ˈaɪtəmz ʃˌʊd biː ɹɪkˈɔːdɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We were told to remain near the gate, then criticised for missing the meal-voucher deadline.
lines.ipa: /wiː wɜː tˈəʊld tə ɹɪmˈeɪn nˌiə ðə ɡˈeɪt ðˈɛn kɹˈɪtɪsˌaɪzd fɔː mˈɪsɪŋ ðə mˈiːlvˈaʊtʃə dˈɛdlaɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were the two announcements made in the same place?
lines.ipa: /wɜː ðə tˈuː ɐnˈaʊnsmənts mˌeɪd ɪnðə sˈeɪm plˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One came through the app and the other over the airport speakers.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn kˈeɪm θɹuː ðɪ ˈap and ðɪ ˈʌðəɹ ˌəʊvə ðɪ ˈeəpɔːt spˈiːkəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll document the conflicting instructions before accepting that it was our mistake.
lines.ipa: /aɪl dˈɒkjuːmənt ðə kənflˈɪktɪŋ ɪnstɹˈʌkʃənz bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐksˈɛptɪŋ ðˌatɪt wɒz ˌaʊə mɪstˈeɪk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The hire agreement makes us responsible for faults we couldn't reasonably inspect.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈaɪəɹ ɐɡɹˈiːmənt mˌeɪks ˌʌs ɹɪspˈɒnsɪbəl fɔː fˈɒlts wiː kˌʊdənt ɹˈiːzənəbli ɪnspˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which faults are you worried about?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ fˈɒlts ɑː juː wˈʌɹid ɐbˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The staff told us not to test the bikes until we'd signed.
lines.ipa: /ðə stˈaf tˈəʊld ˌʌs nˌɒt tə tˈɛst ðə bˈaɪks ʌntˈɪl wiːd sˈaɪnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then we should ask them to record the condition and allow a check before the hire starts.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn wiː ʃˌʊd ˈask ðˌɛm tə ɹɪkˈɔːd ðə kəndˈɪʃən and ɐlˈaʊ ɐ tʃˈɛk bɪfˌɔː ðə hˈaɪə stˈɑːts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The accessible route adds forty minutes because only one platform has a working lift.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ aksˈɛsəbəl ɹˈuːt ˈadz fˈɔːti mˈɪnɪts bɪkˈɒz ˈəʊnli wˈɒn plˈatfɔːm hɐz ɐ wˈɜːkɪŋ lˈɪft/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has the operator offered assistance with the alternative journey?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðɪ ˈɒpəɹˌeɪtəɹ ˈɒfəd ɐsˈɪstəns wɪððɪ ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪv dʒˈɜːni/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only a link to the route planner.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɐ lˈɪŋk tə ðə ɹˈuːt plˈanə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A longer route may be unavoidable today, but they should explain the actual support available.
lines.ipa: /ɐ lˈɒŋɡə ɹˈuːt mˈeɪ biː ʌnɐvˈɔɪdəbəl tədˈeɪ bˌʌt ðeɪ ʃˌʊd ɛksplˈeɪn ðɪ ˈaktʃuːəl səpˈɔːt ɐvˈeɪləbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The driver changed the route without asking, and the fare rose considerably.
lines.ipa: /ðə dɹˈaɪvə tʃˈeɪndʒd ðə ɹˈuːt wɪðˌaʊt ˈaskɪŋ and ðə fˈeə ɹˈəʊz kənsˈɪdəɹəbli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the original road closed?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl ɹˈəʊd klˈəʊzd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. They said the alternative was usually quicker.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ðeɪ sˈɛd ðɪ ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪv wɒz jˈuːʒuːəli kwˈɪkə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A possible time saving isn't the same as consent to a much higher fare.
lines.ipa: /ɐ pˈɒsɪbəl tˈaɪm sˈeɪvɪŋ ˌɪzənt ðə sˈeɪm az kənsˈɛnt tʊ ɐ mˈʌtʃ hˈaɪə fˈeə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The company offered a voucher instead of returning the fare.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈʌmpəni ˈɒfəd ɐ vˈaʊtʃə ɪnstˈɛd ɒv ɹɪtˈɜːnɪŋ ðə fˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would you use their service again before it expires?
lines.ipa: /wʊd juː jˈuːz ðeə sˈɜːvɪs ɐɡˈɛn bɪfˌɔːɹ ɪt ɛkspˈaɪəz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Probably not. I booked this trip for a one-off event.
lines.ipa: /pɹˈɒbəbli nˈɒt aɪ bˈʊkt ðɪs tɹˈɪp fəɹə wˈɒnˈɒf ɪvˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then make that clear when you ask what refund options apply to your ticket.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn mˌeɪk ðat klˈiə wɛn juː ˈask wɒt ɹɪfˈʌnd ˈɒpʃənz ɐplˈaɪ tə jɔː tˈɪkɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cheapest flight looks attractive until we add luggage and transfers.
lines.ipa: /ðə tʃˈiːpɪst flˈaɪt lˈʊks ɐtɹˈaktɪv ʌntˈɪl wiː ˈad lˈʌɡɪdʒ and tɹˈansfɜːz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The train fare includes bags, and we can work during the journey.
lines.ipa: /ðə tɹˈeɪn fˈeəɹ ɪŋklˈuːdz bˈaɡz and wiː kan wˈɜːk djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðə dʒˈɜːni/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It also gets us there the evening before, so we'd need a hotel.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ˈɔːlsəʊ ɡˈɛts ˌʌs ðeə ðɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ bɪfˈɔː sˌəʊ wiːd nˈiːd ɐ həʊtˈɛl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's compare complete journeys rather than choosing whichever headline price is lower.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts kəmpˈeə kəmplˈiːt dʒˈɜːniz ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn tʃˈuːzɪŋ wɪtʃˈɛvə hˈɛdlaɪn pɹˈaɪs ɪz lˈəʊə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your booking system accepted payment after the hotel was already full.
lines.ipa: /jɔː bˈʊkɪŋ sˈɪstəm ɐksˈɛptɪd pˈeɪmənt ˈaftə ðə həʊtˈɛl wɒz ɔːlɹˌɛdi fˈʊl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can't dispute that the confirmation is valid. We need to find you somewhere suitable.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈɑːnt dɪspjˈuːt ðatðə kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən ɪz vˈalɪd wiː nˈiːd tə fˈaɪnd juː sˈʌmweə sˈuːtəbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A room across town won't work unless transport is included.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɹˈuːm əkɹˌɒs tˈaʊn wəʊnt wˈɜːk ʌnlˈɛs tɹˈanspɔːt ɪz ɪŋklˈuːdɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll check both the replacement room and the transfer before asking you to agree.
lines.ipa: /aɪl tʃˈɛk bˈəʊθ ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt ɹˈuːm and ðə tɹˈansfɜː bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈaskɪŋ juː tʊ ɐɡɹˈiː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Breakfast is included, but every option my daughter can eat carries an extra charge.
lines.ipa: /bɹˈɛkfəst ɪz ɪŋklˈuːdɪd bˌʌt ˈɛvɹɪ ˈɒpʃən maɪ dˈɔːtə kan ˈiːt kˈaɹiz ɐn ˈɛkstɹə tʃˈɑːdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are those dietary needs noted on the booking?
lines.ipa: /ɑː ðəʊz dˈaɪətəɹi nˈiːdz nˈəʊtɪd ɒnðə bˈʊkɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, and we checked with the hotel before paying.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs and wiː tʃˈɛkt wɪððə həʊtˈɛl bɪfˌɔː pˈeɪɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll review that correspondence with the restaurant manager rather than treat this as a new request.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ɹɪvjˈuː ðat kˌɒɹɪspˈɒndəns wɪððə ɹˈɛstɹɒnt mˈanɪdʒə ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn tɹˈiːt ðɪs az ɐ njˈuː ɹɪkwˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The quiet-room supplement seems odd when the ordinary room is beside ongoing building work.
lines.ipa: /ðə kwˈaɪətɹˈuːm sˈʌplɪmənt sˈiːmz ˈɒd wɛn ðɪ ˈɔːdɪnəɹi ɹˈuːm ɪz bɪsˌaɪd ˈɒŋɡəʊɪŋ bˈɪldɪŋ wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The supplement normally applies to rooms facing the garden.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈʌplɪmənt nˈɔːməli ɐplˈaɪz tə ɹˈuːmz fˈeɪsɪŋ ðə ɡˈɑːdən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But this isn't ordinary street noise. The hotel knew about the construction.
lines.ipa: /bˌʌt ðɪs ˌɪzənt ˈɔːdɪnəɹi stɹˈiːt nˈɔɪz ðə həʊtˈɛl njˈuː ɐbˌaʊt ðə kənstɹˈʌkʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a fair distinction. I'll review the charge in light of the work schedule.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ fˈeə dɪstˈɪŋkʃən aɪl ɹɪvjˈuː ðə tʃˈɑːdʒ ɪn lˈaɪt ɒvðə wˈɜːk ʃˈɛdjuːl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I understand that you need the room back. I don't understand why a shower costs another full night.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˌʌndəstˈand ðat juː nˈiːd ðə ɹˈuːm bˈak aɪ dˈəʊnt ˌʌndəstˈand wˌaɪ ɐ ʃˈaʊə kˈɒsts ɐnˈʌðə fˈʊl nˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's how our day-use package is currently priced.
lines.ipa: /ðats hˌaʊ ˌaʊə dˈeɪjˈuːs pˈakɪdʒ ɪz kˈʌɹəntli pɹˈaɪst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you offer access to a changing room instead? I won't need a bed.
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː ˈɒfəɹ ˈaksɛs tʊ ɐ tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ɹˈuːm ɪnstˈɛd aɪ wəʊnt nˈiːd ɐ bˈɛd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll check whether there's an option that matches what you're actually asking for.
lines.ipa: /aɪl tʃˈɛk wˈɛðə ðeəz ɐn ˈɒpʃən ðat mˈatʃɪz wɒt jɔːɹ ˈaktʃuːəli ˈaskɪŋ fɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The charger deposit is larger than the replacement value shown on the receipt.
lines.ipa: /ðə tʃˈɑːdʒə dɪpˈɒzɪt ɪz lˈɑːdʒə ðɐn ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt vˈaljuː ʃˈəʊn ɒnðə ɹɪsˈiːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a standard amount for borrowed equipment.
lines.ipa: /ɪts ɐ stˈandəd ɐmˈaʊnt fɔː bˈɒɹəʊd ɪkwˈɪpmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Wouldn't an item-specific deposit be more reasonable?
lines.ipa: /wˈʊdənt ɐn ˈaɪtəmspəsˈɪfɪk dɪpˈɒzɪt biː mˈɔː ɹˈiːzənəbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can't change the policy today, but I can explain it and pass on that suggestion.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈɑːnt tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə pˈɒlɪsi tədˈeɪ bˌʌt aɪ kan ɛksplˈeɪn ɪt and pˈas ˌɒn ðat sədʒˈɛstʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The laundry damaged a shirt, and the offer covers only another wash.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈɔːndɹi dˈamɪdʒd ɐ ʃˈɜːt and ðɪ ˈɒfə kˈʌvəz ˈəʊnli ɐnˈʌðə wˈɒʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the damage acknowledged in the inspection?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə dˈamɪdʒ ɐknˈɒlɪdʒd ɪnðɪ ɪnspˈɛkʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. The fabric has shrunk, so washing it again won't solve it.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə fˈabɹɪk hɐz ʃɹˈʌŋk sˌəʊ wˈɒʃɪŋ ɪt ɐɡˈɛn wəʊnt sˈɒlv ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the proposed remedy doesn't address the finding. I'll ask for the claim to be reviewed.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə pɹəpˈəʊzd ɹˈɛmədi dˈʌzənt ɐdɹˈɛs ðə fˈaɪndɪŋ aɪl ˈask fəðə klˈeɪm təbi ɹɪvjˈuːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The discounted booking was non-refundable, but the hotel cancelled the event it was sold with.
lines.ipa: /ðə dɪskˈaʊntɪd bˈʊkɪŋ wɒz nˈɒnɹɪfˈʌndəbəl bˌʌt ðə həʊtˈɛl kˈansəld ðɪ ɪvˈɛnt ɪt wɒz sˈəʊld wɪð/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the room part of a package on our site?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə ɹˈuːm pˈɑːt əvə pˈakɪdʒ ˌɒn ˌaʊə sˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was advertised as an event stay, not as a separate purchase.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wɒz ˈadvətˌaɪzd az ɐn ɪvˈɛnt stˈeɪ nˌɒt az ɐ sˈɛpɹət pˈɜːtʃɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Please send that confirmation. The package wording matters to how we handle this.
lines.ipa: /plˈiːz sˈɛnd ðat kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən ðə pˈakɪdʒ wˈɜːdɪŋ mˈatəz tə hˌaʊ wiː hˈandəl ðˈɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You replaced my lost key without checking who was standing beside me.
lines.ipa: /juː ɹɪplˈeɪst maɪ lˈɒst kˈiː wɪðˌaʊt tʃˈɛkɪŋ hˌuː wɒz stˈandɪŋ bɪsˈaɪd mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the receptionist ask for your name or identification?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə ɹɪsˈɛpʃənˌɪst ˈask fɔː jɔː nˈeɪm ɔːɹ aɪdˈɛntɪfɪkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only the room number, which I said aloud.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ðə ɹˈuːm nˈʌmbə wˌɪtʃ aɪ sˈɛd ɐlˈaʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That needs investigating. Convenience at the desk shouldn't undermine room security.
lines.ipa: /ðat nˈiːdz ɪnvˈɛstɪɡˌeɪtɪŋ kənvˈiːnɪəns at ðə dˈɛsk ʃˌʊdənt ˌʌndəmˈaɪn ɹˈuːm sɪkjˈʊəɹɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our company needs an itemised invoice, but you've merged everything into accommodation.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə kˈʌmpəni nˈiːdz ɐn ˈaɪtəmˌaɪzd ˈɪnvɔɪs bˌʌt juːv mˈɜːdʒd ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ˌɪntʊ ɐkˌɒmədˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were meals and transport charged separately during your stay?
lines.ipa: /wɜː mˈiːlz and tɹˈanspɔːt tʃˈɑːdʒd sˈɛpɹətli djˈʊəɹɪŋ jɔː stˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. The totals are correct, but the categories aren't.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə tˈəʊtəlz ɑː kəɹˈɛkt bˌʌt ðə kˈatɪɡəɹiz ˈɑːnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll request a corrected breakdown instead of simply printing the same invoice again.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ɹɪkwˈɛst ɐ kəɹˈɛktɪd bɹˈeɪkdaʊn ɪnstˈɛd ɒv sˈɪmpli pɹˈɪntɪŋ ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪnvɔɪs ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd like the review to reflect how well the night manager dealt with the problem.
lines.ipa: /aɪd lˈaɪk ðə ɹɪvjˈuː tə ɹɪflˈɛkt hˌaʊ wˈɛl ðə nˈaɪt mˈanɪdʒə dˈɛlt wɪððə pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then describe what happened before and after you contacted them.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dɪskɹˈaɪb wɒt hˈapənd bɪfˌɔː and ˈaftə juː kˈɒntaktɪd ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't want the initial fault to cancel out their effort.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt ðɪ ɪnˈɪʃəl fˈɒlt tə kˈansəl ˈaʊt ðeəɹ ˈɛfət/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can acknowledge the recovery while still explaining what needed recovering.
lines.ipa: /juː kan ɐknˈɒlɪdʒ ðə ɹɪkˈʌvəɹi wˌaɪl stˈɪl ɛksplˈeɪnɪŋ wɒt nˈiːdɪd ɹɪkˈʌvəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The assistant keeps recommending this shirt because it's discounted, not because it fits.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɐsˈɪstənt kˈiːps ɹˌɛkəmˈɛndɪŋ ðɪs ʃˈɜːt bɪkˈɒz ɪts dɪskˈaʊntɪd nˌɒt bɪkˈɒz ɪt fˈɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you tried the size you originally asked for?
lines.ipa: /hav juː tɹˈaɪd ðə sˈaɪz juː əɹˈɪdʒɪnəli ˈaskt fɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They say it wouldn't look as fashionable.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ sˈeɪ ɪt wˈʊdənt lˈʊk az fˈaʃənəbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A good fit shouldn't be talked away by a sales target. Ask to compare both.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɡˈʊd fˈɪt ʃˌʊdənt biː tˈɔːkt ɐwˈeɪ baɪ ɐ sˈeɪlz tˈɑːɡɪt ˈask tə kəmpˈeə bˈəʊθ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You accepted the return online, but the shop says the item is excluded.
lines.ipa: /juː ɐksˈɛptɪd ðə ɹɪtˈɜːn ˈɒnlaɪn bˌʌt ðə ʃˈɒp sˈɛz ðɪ ˈaɪtəm ɪz ɛksklˈuːdɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the online form identify the exact product?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðɪ ˈɒnlaɪn fˈɔːm aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪ ðɪ ɛɡzˈakt pɹˈɒdʌkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. It generated a return label for this order.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ɪt dʒˈɛnəɹˌeɪtɪd ɐ ɹɪtˈɜːn lˈeɪbəl fɔː ðɪs ˈɔːdə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then we'll need to resolve the conflicting advice before deciding whether another journey is necessary.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn wiːl nˈiːd tə ɹɪzˈɒlv ðə kənflˈɪktɪŋ ɐdvˈaɪs bɪfˌɔː dɪsˈaɪdɪŋ wˈɛðəɹ ɐnˈʌðə dʒˈɜːni ɪz nˈɛsɪsəɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The bundle saves money only if I want all three products.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈʌndəl sˈeɪvz mˈʌni ˈəʊnli ɪf aɪ wˈɒnt ˈɔːl θɹˈiː pɹˈɒdʌkts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's true, although the headline compares it with buying each one separately.
lines.ipa: /ðats tɹˈuː ɔːlðˈəʊ ðə hˈɛdlaɪn kəmpˈeəz ɪt wɪð bˈaɪɪŋ ˈiːtʃ wˈɒn sˈɛpɹətli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I only came for the smallest item.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈəʊnli kˈeɪm fəðə smˈɔːlɪst ˈaɪtəm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In that case, the standalone price is the comparison that matters to you.
lines.ipa: /ɪn ðat kˈeɪs ðə stˈandɐlˌəʊn pɹˈaɪs ɪz ðə kəmpˈaɹɪsən ðat mˈatəz tə juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've explained the fault four times, and every new agent starts again.
lines.ipa: /aɪv ɛksplˈeɪnd ðə fˈɒlt fˈɔː tˈaɪmz and ˈɛvɹɪ njˈuː ˈeɪdʒənt stˈɑːts ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you been given a case number?
lines.ipa: /hav juː bˌiːn ɡˈɪvən ɐ kˈeɪs nˈʌmbə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Three different ones, none linked to the original purchase.
lines.ipa: /θɹˈiː dˈɪfɹənt wˌɒnz nˈɒn lˈɪŋkt tə ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl pˈɜːtʃɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll ask for one record that includes the replacements, rather than open another isolated complaint.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ˈask fɔː wˈɒn ɹˈɛkɔːd ðat ɪŋklˈuːdz ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənts ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ˈəʊpən ɐnˈʌðəɹ ˈaɪsəlˌeɪtɪd kəmplˈeɪnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The collection code was used before I received the notification.
lines.ipa: /ðə kəlˈɛkʃən kˈəʊd wɒz jˈuːzd bɪfˌɔːɹ aɪ ɹɪsˈiːvd ðə nˌəʊtɪfɪkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could someone else have accessed the account?
lines.ipa: /kʊd sˈʌmwɒn ˈɛls hav ˈaksɛst ðɪ ɐkˈaʊnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not that I know of. I don't want us to assume that without checking.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt ðat aɪ nˈəʊ ɒv aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt ˌʌs tʊ ɐsjˈuːm ðat wɪðˌaʊt tʃˈɛkɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We'll preserve the collection record and investigate who verified the handover.
lines.ipa: /wiːl pɹɪzˈɜːv ðə kəlˈɛkʃən ɹˈɛkɔːd and ɪnvˈɛstɪɡˌeɪt hˌuː vˈɛɹɪfˌaɪd ðə hˈandəʊvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your gift service promises discreet delivery, but the packaging shows the product name.
lines.ipa: /jɔː ɡˈɪft sˈɜːvɪs pɹˈɒmɪsɪz dɪskɹˈiːt dɪlˈɪvəɹi bˌʌt ðə pˈakɪdʒɪŋ ʃˈəʊz ðə pɹˈɒdʌkt nˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was that clear in the images before purchase?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ðat klˈiəɹ ɪnðɪ ˈɪmɪdʒɪz bɪfˌɔː pˈɜːtʃɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. The only image showed a plain outer box.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ðɪ ˈəʊnli ˈɪmɪdʒ ʃˈəʊd ɐ plˈeɪn ˈaʊtə bˈɒks/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the delivery didn't match the presentation. I'll take a photograph before contacting support.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə dɪlˈɪvəɹi dˈɪdnt mˈatʃ ðə pɹˌɛzəntˈeɪʃən aɪl tˈeɪk ɐ fˈəʊtəɡɹˌaf bɪfˌɔː kˈɒntaktɪŋ səpˈɔːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The voucher has no expiry date on the front, and the link on the back no longer works.
lines.ipa: /ðə vˈaʊtʃə hɐz nˈəʊ ɛkspˈaɪəɹi dˈeɪt ɒnðə fɹˈʌnt and ðə lˈɪŋk ɒnðə bˈak nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡə wˈɜːks/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does the purchase email contain the terms?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðə pˈɜːtʃɪs ˈiːmeɪl kəntˈeɪn ðə tˈɜːmz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It repeats the same broken link.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ɹɪpˈiːts ðə sˈeɪm bɹˈəʊkən lˈɪŋk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We shouldn't invent a condition now. I'll ask the issuer to supply the original terms.
lines.ipa: /wiː ʃˌʊdənt ɪnvˈɛnt ɐ kəndˈɪʃən nˈaʊ aɪl ˈask ðɪ ˈɪʃuːə tə səplˈaɪ ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl tˈɜːmz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The used bike comes with a warranty, but it excludes the parts most likely to wear out.
lines.ipa: /ðə jˈuːzd bˈaɪk kˈʌmz wɪð ɐ wˈɒɹənti bˌʌt ɪt ɛksklˈuːdz ðə pˈɑːts mˈəʊst lˈaɪkli tə wˈeəɹ ˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That doesn't necessarily make it worthless. What does it actually cover?
lines.ipa: /ðat dˈʌzənt nˌɛsɪsˈɛɹɪli mˌeɪk ɪt wˈɜːθləs wˌɒt dˈʌz ɪt ˈaktʃuːəli kˈʌvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The frame and a few fixed components.
lines.ipa: /ðə fɹˈeɪm and ɐ fjˈuː fˈɪkst kəmpˈəʊnənts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then judge the price with the likely maintenance costs included, not as if every repair were covered.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dʒˈʌdʒ ðə pɹˈaɪs wɪððə lˈaɪkli mˈeɪntənəns kˈɒsts ɪŋklˈuːdɪd nˌɒt az ɪf ˈɛvɹɪ ɹɪpˈeə wɜː kˈʌvəd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This package is labelled plastic-free, yet the protective lining looks synthetic.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs pˈakɪdʒ ɪz lˈeɪbəld plˈastɪkfɹˈiː jˈɛt ðə pɹətˈɛktɪv lˈaɪnɪŋ lˈʊks sɪnθˈɛtɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It may be a coated paper rather than a separate plastic layer.
lines.ipa: /ɪt mˈeɪ biː ɐ kˈəʊtɪd pˈeɪpə ɹˈɑːðə ðˌanə sˈɛpɹət plˈastɪk lˈeɪə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you confirm the material instead of guessing from its appearance?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː kənfˈɜːm ðə mətˈiəɹiəl ɪnstˈɛd ɒv ɡˈɛsɪŋ fɹɒm ɪts ɐpˈiəɹəns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll check the supplier's specification before making another environmental claim.
lines.ipa: /aɪl tʃˈɛk ðə səplˈaɪəz spˌɛsɪfɪkˈeɪʃən bɪfˌɔː mˌeɪkɪŋ ɐnˈʌðəɹ ɛnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl klˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The pre-order guarantee says lowest price, but my refund was calculated using a later promotion.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹˈiːˈɔːdə ɡˌaɹəntˈiː sˈɛz lˈəʊɪst pɹˈaɪs bˌʌt maɪ ɹˈiːfʌnd wɒz kˈalkjʊlˌeɪtɪd jˈuːzɪŋ ɐ lˈeɪtə pɹəmˈəʊʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the item itself cheaper during that promotion?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðɪ ˈaɪtəm ɪtsˈɛlf tʃˈiːpə djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðat pɹəmˈəʊʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, though only when bought with an accessory.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðˌəʊ ˈəʊnli wɛn bˈɔːt wɪð ɐn ɐksˈɛsəɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We'll need the exact offer conditions to see whether the guarantee applies.
lines.ipa: /wiːl nˈiːd ðɪ ɛɡzˈakt ˈɒfə kəndˈɪʃənz tə sˈiː wˈɛðə ðə ɡˌaɹəntˈiː ɐplˈaɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our rota allocates the same number of jobs, but one person manages all the reminders.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə ɹˈəʊtəɹ ˈaləkˌeɪts ðə sˈeɪm nˈʌmbəɹ ɒv dʒˈɒbz bˌʌt wˈɒn pˈɜːsən mˈanɪdʒɪz ˈɔːl ðə ɹɪmˈaɪndəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the list ignores the work of noticing and organising?
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə lˈɪst ɪɡnˈɔːz ðə wˈɜːk ɒv nˈəʊtɪsɪŋ and ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. The visible tasks look fair while the planning falls to me.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðə vˈɪzɪbəl tˈasks lˈʊk fˈeə wˌaɪl ðə plˈanɪŋ fˈɔːlz tə mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's include that responsibility rather than count only the jobs that end with a clean room.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts ɪŋklˈuːd ðat ɹɪspˌɒnsəbˈɪlɪti ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn kˈaʊnt ˈəʊnli ðə dʒˈɒbz ðat ˈɛnd wɪð ɐ klˈiːn ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The repair was marked complete because the leak stopped during the visit.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪpˈeə wɒz mˈɑːkt kəmplˈiːt bɪkˈɒz ðə lˈiːk stˈɒpt djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðə vˈɪzɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has it happened again under the same conditions as before?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ɪt hˈapənd ɐɡˈɛn ˌʌndə ðə sˈeɪm kəndˈɪʃənz az bɪfˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, whenever both appliances run together.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs wɛnˌɛvə bˈəʊθ ɐplˈaɪənsɪz ɹˈʌn təɡˈɛðə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the report needs to describe that pattern, otherwise each visit starts from the wrong assumption.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt nˈiːdz tə dɪskɹˈaɪb ðat pˈatən ˈʌðəwˌaɪz ˈiːtʃ vˈɪzɪt stˈɑːts fɹʌmðə ɹˈɒŋ ɐsˈʌmpʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd rather not lend the ladder until we've settled who pays for the damaged part.
lines.ipa: /aɪd ɹˈɑːðə nˌɒt lˈɛnd ðə lˈadəɹ ʌntˈɪl wiːv sˈɛtəld hˌuː pˈeɪz fəðə dˈamɪdʒd pˈɑːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you think your neighbour knows that's why you refused?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk jɔː nˈeɪbə nˈəʊz ðats wˌaɪ juː ɹɪfjˈuːzd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Probably not. I only said I needed it.
lines.ipa: /pɹˈɒbəbli nˈɒt aɪ ˈəʊnli sˈɛd aɪ nˈiːdɪd ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Being clear about the unresolved damage may be less awkward than another vague excuse.
lines.ipa: /bˌiːɪŋ klˈiəɹ ɐbˌaʊt ðɪ ˌʌnɹɪzˈɒlvd dˈamɪdʒ mˈeɪ biː lˈɛs ˈɔːkwəd ðɐn ɐnˈʌðə vˈeɪɡ ɛkskjˈuːs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The parcel was photographed on my doorstep, but that doesn't prove I received it.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈɑːsəl wɒz fˈəʊtəɡɹˌaft ˌɒn maɪ dˈɔːstɛp bˌʌt ðat dˈʌzənt pɹˈuːv aɪ ɹɪsˈiːvd ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was leaving it there one of the delivery options you selected?
lines.ipa: /wɒz lˈiːvɪŋ ɪt ðeə wˈɒn ɒvðə dɪlˈɪvəɹi ˈɒpʃənz juː sɪlˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. I asked for a handover.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ aɪ ˈaskt fəɹə hˈandəʊvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep the photo as evidence of where it was left, not as confirmation that it reached you.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðə fˈəʊtəʊ az ˈɛvɪdəns ɒv wˌeəɹ ɪt wɒz lˈɛft nˌɒt az kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən ðˌatɪt ɹˈiːtʃt juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't want to control when my neighbours do their washing.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt tə kəntɹˈəʊl wɛn maɪ nˈeɪbəz dˈuː ðeə wˈɒʃɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You just need the machine not to shake the bedroom wall at midnight.
lines.ipa: /juː dʒˈʌst nˈiːd ðə məʃˈiːn nˌɒt tə ʃˈeɪk ðə bˈɛdɹuːm wˈɔːl at mˈɪdnaɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. The conversation keeps turning into whether I dislike their routine.
lines.ipa: /ɹˈaɪt ðə kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən kˈiːps tˈɜːnɪŋ ˌɪntʊ wˈɛðəɹ aɪ dɪslˈaɪk ðeə ɹuːtˈiːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Start with the specific disturbance and ask what adjustments might reduce it.
lines.ipa: /stˈɑːt wɪððə spəsˈɪfɪk dɪstˈɜːbəns and ˈask wɒt ɐdʒˈʌstmənts mˌaɪt ɹɪdjˈuːs ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The flatmate interview went well until we mentioned guests.
lines.ipa: /ðə flˈatmeɪt ˈɪntəvjˌuː wɛnt wˈɛl ʌntˈɪl wiː mˈɛnʃənd ɡˈɛsts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you have different expectations about overnight stays?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː hav dˈɪfɹənt ɛkspɪktˈeɪʃənz ɐbˌaʊt ˌəʊvənˈaɪt stˈeɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Very different, though neither of us thought to ask at first.
lines.ipa: /vˈɛɹi dˈɪfɹənt ðˌəʊ nˈaɪðəɹ ɒv ˌʌs θˈɔːt tʊ ˈask at fˈɜːst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better to find that out now than treat incompatible assumptions as bad behaviour later.
lines.ipa: /bˈɛtə tə fˈaɪnd ðat ˈaʊt nˈaʊ ðɐn tɹˈiːt ɪŋkəmpˈatɪbəl ɐsˈʌmpʃənz az bˈad bɪhˈeɪvjə lˈeɪtə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The moving company priced the job before learning there's no lift.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈuːvɪŋ kˈʌmpəni pɹˈaɪst ðə dʒˈɒb bɪfˌɔː lˈɜːnɪŋ ðeəz nˈəʊ lˈɪft/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the quotation say they had checked access?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə kwəʊtˈeɪʃən sˈeɪ ðeɪ had tʃˈɛkt ˈaksɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It says fixed price based on the information provided.
lines.ipa: /ɪt sˈɛz fˈɪkst pɹˈaɪs bˈeɪst ɒnðɪ ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən pɹəvˈaɪdɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then send the correct access details and get the revised position confirmed before moving day.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn sˈɛnd ðə kəɹˈɛkt ˈaksɛs dˈiːteɪlz and ɡɛt ðə ɹɪvˈaɪzd pəzˈɪʃən kənfˈɜːmd bɪfˌɔː mˈuːvɪŋ dˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We've improved the heating system but still leave the windows open to cool the rooms.
lines.ipa: /wiːv ɪmpɹˈuːvd ðə hˈiːtɪŋ sˈɪstəm bˌʌt stˈɪl lˈiːv ðə wˈɪndəʊz ˈəʊpən tə kˈuːl ðə ɹˈuːmz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That suggests the controls may be the problem now.
lines.ipa: /ðat sədʒˈɛsts ðə kəntɹˈəʊlz mˈeɪ biː ðə pɹˈɒbləm nˈaʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everyone sets a different temperature, then tries to correct it locally.
lines.ipa: /ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn sˈɛts ɐ dˈɪfɹənt tˈɛmpɹɪtʃə ðˈɛn tɹˈaɪz tə kəɹˈɛkt ɪt lˈəʊkəli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Agreeing how to use the system could matter as much as the equipment itself.
lines.ipa: /ɐɡɹˈiːɪŋ hˌaʊ tə jˈuːz ðə sˈɪstəm kʊd mˈatəɹ az mˈʌtʃ az ðɪ ɪkwˈɪpmənt ɪtsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The renewed lease allows inspections at very short notice.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪnjˈuːd lˈiːs ɐlˈaʊz ɪnspˈɛkʃənz at vˈɛɹi ʃˈɔːt nˈəʊtɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was that provision in the old agreement?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ðat pɹəvˈɪʒən ɪnðɪ ˈəʊld ɐɡɹˈiːmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, and the agent called the whole document a routine renewal.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ and ðɪ ˈeɪdʒənt kˈɔːld ðə hˈəʊl dˈɒkjuːmənt ɐ ɹuːtˈiːn ɹɪnjˈuːəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A routine label doesn't remove the need to read the changed terms.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɹuːtˈiːn lˈeɪbəl dˈʌzənt ɹɪmˈuːv ðə nˈiːd tə ɹˈiːd ðə tʃˈeɪndʒd tˈɜːmz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our pet sitter followed every instruction, but our dog was clearly distressed.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə pˈɛt sˈɪtə fˈɒləʊd ˈɛvɹɪ ɪnstɹˈʌkʃən bˌʌt ˌaʊə dˈɒɡ wɒz klˈiəli dɪstɹˈɛst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were the instructions based on how he behaves when you're home?
lines.ipa: /wɜː ðɪ ɪnstɹˈʌkʃənz bˈeɪst ˌɒn hˌaʊ hiː bɪhˈeɪvz wɛn jɔː hˈəʊm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. We assumed he'd settle in the same way.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs wiː ɐsjˈuːmd hiːd sˈɛtəl ɪnðə sˈeɪm wˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Next time we should arrange a trial visit rather than rely entirely on familiar routines.
lines.ipa: /nˈɛkst tˈaɪm wiː ʃˌʊd ɐɹˈeɪndʒ ɐ tɹˈaɪəl vˈɪzɪt ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɹɪlˈaɪ ɛntˈaɪəli ˌɒn fəmˈɪliə ɹuːtˈiːnz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I finally booked the appointment I'd been putting off.
lines.ipa: /aɪ fˈaɪnəli bˈʊkt ðɪ ɐpˈɔɪntmənt aɪd bˌiːn pˈʊtɪŋ ˈɒf/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was finding a convenient time the hard part?
lines.ipa: /wɒz fˈaɪndɪŋ ɐ kənvˈiːnɪənt tˈaɪm ðə hˈɑːd pˈɑːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Actually, it was making the call. Once I did, the booking took two minutes.
lines.ipa: /ˈaktʃuːəli ɪt wɒz mˌeɪkɪŋ ðə kˈɔːl wˈʌns aɪ dˈɪd ðə bˈʊkɪŋ tˈʊk tˈuː mˈɪnɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sometimes the task grows in your mind while it sits on the list.
lines.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz ðə tˈask ɡɹˈəʊz ɪn jɔː mˈaɪnd wˌaɪl ɪt sˈɪts ɒnðə lˈɪst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I signed up for a beginner class and recognised half the people there.
lines.ipa: /aɪ sˈaɪnd ˌʌp fəɹə bɪɡˈɪnə klˈas and ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzd hˈɑːf ðə pˈiːpəl ðˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were they beginners too?
lines.ipa: /wɜː ðeɪ bɪɡˈɪnəz tˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Some were returning after a long break. That made it feel much less intimidating.
lines.ipa: /sˌʌm wɜː ɹɪtˈɜːnɪŋ ˈaftəɹ ɐ lˈɒŋ bɹˈeɪk ðat mˌeɪd ɪt fˈiːl mˈʌtʃ lˈɛs ɪntˈɪmɪdˌeɪtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It helps when starting again doesn't mean pretending you've never tried before.
lines.ipa: /ɪt hˈɛlps wɛn stˈɑːtɪŋ ɐɡˈɛn dˈʌzənt mˈiːn pɹɪtˈɛndɪŋ juːv nˈɛvə tɹˈaɪd bɪfˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I kept a quiet evening free and then felt I ought to fill it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈɛpt ɐ kwˈaɪət ˈiːvnɪŋ fɹˈiː and ðˈɛn fˈɛlt aɪ ˈɔːt tə fˈɪl ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You've become very good at treating spare time as unfinished work.
lines.ipa: /juːv bɪkˌʌm vˈɛɹi ɡˈʊd at tɹˈiːtɪŋ spˈeə tˈaɪm az ʌnfˈɪnɪʃt wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's uncomfortably accurate. I even made a list of relaxing activities.
lines.ipa: /ðats ʌŋkˈʌmftəbli ˈakjʊɹət aɪ ˈiːvən mˌeɪd ɐ lˈɪst ɒv ɹɪlˈaksɪŋ aktˈɪvɪtiz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You could try leaving the list in another room for once.
lines.ipa: /juː kʊd tɹˈaɪ lˈiːvɪŋ ðə lˈɪst ɪn ɐnˈʌðə ɹˈuːm fɔː wˈʌns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The waiter said they'd check the ingredients, which I appreciated more than a quick reassurance.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈeɪtə sˈɛd ðeɪd tʃˈɛk ðɪ ɪŋɡɹˈiːdiənts wˌɪtʃ aɪ ɐpɹˈiːʃɪˌeɪtɪd mˈɔː ðˌanə kwˈɪk ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹəns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They didn't simply tell you what you wanted to hear.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ dˈɪdnt sˈɪmpli tˈɛl juː wɒt juː wˈɒntɪd tə hˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Waiting a few minutes felt better than getting an uncertain answer immediately.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli wˈeɪtɪŋ ɐ fjˈuː mˈɪnɪts fˈɛlt bˈɛtə ðɐn ɡˌɛtɪŋ ɐn ʌnsˈɜːtən ˈansəɹ ɪmˈiːdɪətli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Careful service isn't always the fastest service.
lines.ipa: /kˈeəfəl sˈɜːvɪs ˌɪzənt ˈɔːlweɪz ðə fˈastɪst sˈɜːvɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our walking group now has a slower route, and it's unexpectedly popular.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə wˈɔːkɪŋ ɡɹˈuːp nˈaʊ hɐz ɐ slˈəʊə ɹˈuːt and ɪts ˌʌnɛkspˈɛktɪdli pˈɒpjʊlə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because it's easier?
lines.ipa: /bɪkˈɒz ɪts ˈiːziə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Partly, but people also like having time to talk and notice things.
lines.ipa: /pˈɑːtli bˌʌt pˈiːpəl ˈɔːlsəʊ lˈaɪk hˌavɪŋ tˈaɪm tə tˈɔːk and nˈəʊtɪs θˈɪŋz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The original assumption that everyone wanted a faster pace may have been too narrow.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl ɐsˈʌmpʃən ðat ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn wˈɒntɪd ɐ fˈastə pˈeɪs mˌeɪhɐv bˌiːn tˈuː nˈaɹəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought the new refill point would be difficult to use, but the instructions are excellent.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt ðə njˈuː ɹɪfˈɪl pˈɔɪnt wʊd biː dˈɪfɪkəlt tə jˈuːz bˌʌt ðɪ ɪnstɹˈʌkʃənz ɑːɹ ˈɛksələnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What makes them work?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt mˌeɪks ðˌɛm wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They show one step at a time, and the buttons are at a reachable height.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ʃˈəʊ wˈɒn stˈɛp atə tˈaɪm and ðə bˈʌtənz ɑːɹ atə ɹˈiːtʃəbəl hˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a good example to send with feedback about the older facilities.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ ɡˈʊd ɛɡzˈampəl tə sˈɛnd wɪð fˈiːdbak ɐbˌaʊt ðɪ ˈəʊldə fəsˈɪlɪtiz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I moved one meeting and suddenly had a proper lunch break.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈuːvd wˈɒn mˈiːtɪŋ and sˈʌdənli had ɐ pɹˈɒpə lˈʌntʃ bɹˈeɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did anyone object?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ˈɛnɪwˌɒn ˈɒbdʒɛkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nobody. I'd been assuming the original time was fixed for a reason.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊbɒdi aɪd bˌiːn ɐsjˈuːmɪŋ ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl tˈaɪm wɒz fˈɪkst fəɹə ɹˈiːzən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's remarkable how many arrangements survive simply because no one questions them.
lines.ipa: /ɪts ɹɪmˈɑːkəbəl hˌaʊ mˈɛni ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənts səvˈaɪv sˈɪmpli bɪkˈɒz nˈəʊwˈɒn kwˈɛstʃənz ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cancelled class was replaced with a smaller workshop.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈansəld klˈas wɒz ɹɪplˈeɪst wɪð ɐ smˈɔːlə wˈɜːkʃɒp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was that what you'd expected?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ðat wɒt juːd ɛkspˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not at all, but we received more individual attention than usual.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt at ˈɔːl bˌʌt wiː ɹɪsˈiːvd mˈɔːɹ ˌɪndɪvˈɪdʒuːəl ɐtˈɛnʃən ðɐn jˈuːʒuːəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A change can work well when people are told honestly what they're being offered.
lines.ipa: /ɐ tʃˈeɪndʒ kan wˈɜːk wˈɛl wɛn pˈiːpəl ɑː tˈəʊld ˈɒnɪstli wɒt ðeɪə bˌiːɪŋ ˈɒfəd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I stopped comparing this month's progress with someone else's.
lines.ipa: /aɪ stˈɒpt kəmpˈeəɹɪŋ ðɪs mˈʌnθz pɹˈəʊɡɹɛs wɪð sˈʌmwɒn ˈɛlsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What changed your mind?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt tʃˈeɪndʒd jɔː mˈaɪnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I realised their starting point and their available time were completely different from mine.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹˈiəlaɪzd ðeə stˈɑːtɪŋ pˈɔɪnt and ðeəɹ ɐvˈeɪləbəl tˈaɪm wɜː kəmplˈiːtli dˈɪfɹənt fɹɒm mˈaɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then a shared target was hiding more than it was measuring.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ɐ ʃˈeəd tˈɑːɡɪt wɒz hˈaɪdɪŋ mˈɔː ðɐn ɪt wɒz mˈɛʒəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The centre invited users to test the renovated changing rooms before reopening.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɛntəɹ ɪnvˈaɪtɪd jˈuːzəz tə tˈɛst ðə ɹˈɛnəvˌeɪtɪd tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ɹˈuːmz bɪfˌɔː ɹɪˈəʊpənɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did they find anything the design team had missed?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðeɪ fˈaɪnd ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ðə dɪzˈaɪn tˈiːm had mˈɪst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Several small things, including a hook nobody could reach from a seated position.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛvɹəl smˈɔːl θˈɪŋz ɪŋklˈuːdɪŋ ɐ hˈʊk nˈəʊbɒdi kʊd ɹˈiːtʃ fɹɒm ɐ sˈiːtɪd pəzˈɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sort of early feedback can save a lot of expensive rework.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈɔːt ɒv ˈɜːlɪ fˈiːdbak kan sˈeɪv ɐ lˈɒt ɒv ɛkspˈɛnsɪv ɹɪwˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I found an older edition of the textbook for a fraction of the price.
lines.ipa: /aɪ fˈaʊnd ɐn ˈəʊldəɹ ɪdˈɪʃən ɒvðə tˈɛkstbʊk fəɹə fɹˈakʃən ɒvðə pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does it cover the material your course actually uses?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ɪt kˈʌvə ðə mətˈiəɹiəl jɔː kˈɔːs ˈaktʃuːəli jˈuːsɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mostly. I compared the contents rather than assuming newer meant necessary.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊstli aɪ kəmpˈeəd ðə kˈɒntɛnts ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐsjˈuːmɪŋ njˈuːə mˈɛnt nˈɛsɪsəɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Check any changed references, and it could be a sensible option.
lines.ipa: /tʃˈɛk ˌɛni tʃˈeɪndʒd ɹˈɛfɹənsɪz and ɪt kʊd biː ɐ sˈɛnsɪbəl ˈɒpʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The homework question finally made sense when I explained what confused me.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈəʊmwɜːk kwˈɛstʃən fˈaɪnəli mˌeɪd sˈɛns wɛn aɪ ɛksplˈeɪnd wɒt kənfjˈuːzd mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: To the teacher?
lines.ipa: /tə ðə tˈiːtʃə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: To my flatmate, who knows nothing about the subject.
lines.ipa: /tə maɪ flˈatmeɪt hˌuː nˈəʊz nˈʌθɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt ðə sˈʌbdʒɛkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Putting the problem into words can reveal the missing step.
lines.ipa: /pˈʊtɪŋ ðə pɹˈɒbləm ˌɪntʊ wˈɜːdz kan ɹɪvˈiːl ðə mˈɪsɪŋ stˈɛp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our study group agreed that nobody has to arrive with a perfect answer.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə stˈʌdi ɡɹˈuːp ɐɡɹˈiːd ðat nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz tʊ ɐɹˈaɪv wɪð ɐ pˈɜːfɛkt ˈansə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has that changed the discussions?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðat tʃˈeɪndʒd ðə dɪskˈʌʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A lot. People now bring half-formed ideas instead of staying silent.
lines.ipa: /ɐ lˈɒt pˈiːpəl nˈaʊ bɹˈɪŋ hˈɑːffˈɔːmd aɪdˈiəz ɪnstˈɛd ɒv stˈeɪɪŋ sˈaɪlənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That gives the group something to work on rather than just something to admire.
lines.ipa: /ðat ɡˈɪvz ðə ɡɹˈuːp sˈʌmθɪŋ tə wˈɜːk ˌɒn ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn dʒˈʌst sˈʌmθɪŋ tʊ ɐdmˈaɪə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was offered an extension but decided to submit the smaller project on time.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɒz ˈɒfəd ɐn ɛkstˈɛnʃən bˌʌt dɪsˈaɪdɪd tə səbmˈɪt ðə smˈɔːlə pɹˈɒdʒɛkt ˌɒn tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why not take the extra days?
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ nˌɒt tˈeɪk ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə dˈeɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The main argument was ready. I'd been adding material that didn't really support it.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈeɪn ˈɑːɡjuːmənt wɒz ɹˈɛdi aɪd bˌiːn ˈadɪŋ mətˈiəɹiəl ðat dˈɪdnt ɹˈiəlɪ səpˈɔːt ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Knowing what to leave out is part of finishing.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊɪŋ wɒt tə lˈiːv ˈaʊt ɪz pˈɑːt ɒv fˈɪnɪʃɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two tutors gave me feedback that seemed contradictory.
lines.ipa: /tˈuː tjˈuːtəz ɡˈeɪv mˌiː fˈiːdbak ðat sˈiːmd kˌɒntɹədˈɪktəɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were they focusing on the same thing?
lines.ipa: /wɜː ðeɪ fˈəʊkəsɪŋ ɒnðə sˈeɪm θˈɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One wanted more explanation; the other wanted a clearer structure.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn wˈɒntɪd mˈɔːɹ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən ðɪ ˈʌðə wˈɒntɪd ɐ klˈiəɹə stɹˈʌktʃə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You may be able to do both by explaining fewer points more carefully.
lines.ipa: /juː mˈeɪ biː ˈeɪbəl tə dˈuː bˈəʊθ baɪ ɛksplˈeɪnɪŋ fjˈuːə pˈɔɪnts mˈɔː kˈeəfəli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I chose the course with fewer advertised topics.
lines.ipa: /aɪ tʃˈəʊz ðə kˈɔːs wɪð fjˈuːəɹ ˈadvətˌaɪzd tˈɒpɪks/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds unusual. What persuaded you?
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈaʊndz ʌnjˈuːʒuːəl wˌɒt pəswˈeɪdɪd juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sample lessons showed how deeply they explored each one.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈampəl lˈɛsənz ʃˈəʊd hˌaʊ dˈiːpli ðeɪ ɛksplˈɔːd ˈiːtʃ wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A long list can look impressive without telling you much about the learning.
lines.ipa: /ɐ lˈɒŋ lˈɪst kan lˈʊk ɪmpɹˈɛsɪv wɪðˌaʊt tˈɛlɪŋ juː mˈʌtʃ ɐbˌaʊt ðə lˈɜːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: During the rehearsal, someone asked a question I hadn't prepared for.
lines.ipa: /djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðə ɹɪhˈɜːsəl sˈʌmwɒn ˈaskt ɐ kwˈɛstʃən aɪ hˈadənt pɹɪpˈeəd fɔː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did it throw you off?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ɪt θɹˈəʊ juː ˈɒf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: At first, but answering it showed me where my explanation was weak.
lines.ipa: /at fˈɜːst bˌʌt ˈansəɹɪŋ ɪt ʃˈəʊd mˌiː wˌeə maɪ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən wɒz wˈiːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better to discover that with a friendly audience than during the assessment.
lines.ipa: /bˈɛtə tə dɪskˈʌvə ðat wɪð ɐ fɹˈɛndli ˈɔːdiəns ðɐn djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðɪ ɐsˈɛsmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The online lesson felt more interactive after the teacher stopped asking whether everyone understood.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɒnlaɪn lˈɛsən fˈɛlt mˈɔːɹ ˌɪntəɹˈaktɪv ˈaftə ðə tˈiːtʃə stˈɒpt ˈaskɪŋ wˈɛðəɹ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ˌʌndəstˈʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What did they ask instead?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈɪd ðeɪ ˈask ɪnstˈɛd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They gave us a short problem and asked us to explain our choices.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɡˈeɪv ˌʌs ɐ ʃˈɔːt pɹˈɒbləm and ˈaskt ˌʌs tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ˌaʊə tʃˈɔɪsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That produces more useful information than a row of polite nods.
lines.ipa: /ðat pɹədjˈuːsɪz mˈɔː jˈuːsfəl ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən ðˌanə ɹˈəʊ ɒv pəlˈaɪt nˈɒdz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I found the original study behind that dramatic headline.
lines.ipa: /aɪ fˈaʊnd ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl stˈʌdi bɪhˌaɪnd ðat dɹəmˈatɪk hˈɛdlaɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did it support the claim?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ɪt səpˈɔːt ðə klˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only partly. The result applied to a much smaller group than the article suggested.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli pˈɑːtli ðə ɹɪzˈʌlt ɐplˈaɪd tʊ ɐ mˈʌtʃ smˈɔːlə ɡɹˈuːp ðɐn ðɪ ˈɑːtɪkəl sədʒˈɛstɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then your reference needs to reflect the study's limits, not the headline's confidence.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn jɔː ɹˈɛfɹəns nˈiːdz tə ɹɪflˈɛkt ðə stˈʌdiz lˈɪmɪts nˌɒt ðə hˈɛdlaɪnz kˈɒnfɪdəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My revision notes are half as long as they were last week.
lines.ipa: /maɪ ɹɪvˈɪʒən nˈəʊts ɑː hˈɑːf az lˈɒŋ az ðeɪ wɜː lˈast wˈiːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you cut out things you don't need?
lines.ipa: /hav juː kˈʌt ˈaʊt θˈɪŋz juː dˈəʊnt nˈiːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've replaced repeated definitions with examples that show the differences.
lines.ipa: /aɪv ɹɪplˈeɪst ɹɪpˈiːtɪd dˌɛfɪnˈɪʃənz wɪð ɛɡzˈampəlz ðat ʃˈəʊ ðə dˈɪfɹənsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds more useful than making the handwriting smaller.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈaʊndz mˈɔː jˈuːsfəl ðɐn mˌeɪkɪŋ ðə hˈandɹaɪtɪŋ smˈɔːlə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We ended the meeting early because the decision was already clear.
lines.ipa: /wiː ˈɛndɪd ðə mˈiːtɪŋ ˈɜːlɪ bɪkˈɒz ðə dɪsˈɪʒən wɒz ɔːlɹˌɛdi klˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did people feel their time had been wasted?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd pˈiːpəl fˈiːl ðeə tˈaɪm hɐdbɪn wˈeɪstɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Quite the opposite. They were pleased we didn't fill the remaining half-hour.
lines.ipa: /kwˈaɪt ðɪ ˈɒpəzˌɪt ðeɪ wɜː plˈiːzd wiː dˈɪdnt fˈɪl ðə ɹɪmˈeɪnɪŋ hˈɑːfˈaʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An agenda shouldn't become a reason to keep talking after the work is done.
lines.ipa: /ɐn ɐdʒˈɛndə ʃˌʊdənt bɪkˌʌm ɐ ɹˈiːzən tə kˈiːp tˈɔːkɪŋ ˈaftə ðə wˈɜːk ɪz dˈʌn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I asked for help before the deadline became impossible.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈaskt fɔː hˈɛlp bɪfˌɔː ðə dˈɛdlaɪn bɪkˌeɪm ɪmpˈɒsɪbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How did your manager respond?
lines.ipa: /hˌaʊ dˈɪd jɔː mˈanɪdʒə ɹɪspˈɒnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: She moved one task and asked why I'd waited so long on previous projects.
lines.ipa: /ʃiː mˈuːvd wˈɒn tˈask and ˈaskt wˌaɪ aɪd wˈeɪtɪd sˌəʊ lˈɒŋ ˌɒn pɹˈiːviəs pɹˈɒdʒɛkts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's encouraging. You don't have to turn every capacity problem into a personal test.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɛŋkˈʌɹɪdʒɪŋ juː dˈəʊnt hav tə tˈɜːn ˈɛvɹɪ kəpˈasɪti pɹˈɒbləm ˌɪntʊ ɐ pˈɜːsənəl tˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The remote-working trial exposed a problem we used to solve through casual office conversations.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪmˈəʊtwˈɜːkɪŋ tɹˈaɪəl ɛkspˈəʊzd ɐ pɹˈɒbləm wiː jˈuːzd tə sˈɒlv θɹuː kˈaʒuːəl ˈɒfɪs kɒnvəsˈeɪʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What was missing?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt wɒz mˈɪsɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nobody knew when a decision was final unless they'd overheard it.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊbɒdi njˈuː wɛn ɐ dɪsˈɪʒən wɒz fˈaɪnəl ʌnlˈɛs ðeɪd ˌəʊvəhˈɜːd ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Writing down decisions could improve things for office staff as well.
lines.ipa: /ɹˈaɪtɪŋ dˌaʊn dɪsˈɪʒənz kʊd ɪmpɹˈuːv θˈɪŋz fɔːɹ ˈɒfɪs stˈaf az wˈɛl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I rewrote the instructions while following them as if I were new.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹɪɹˈəʊt ðɪ ɪnstɹˈʌkʃənz wˌaɪl fˈɒləʊɪŋ ðˌɛm az ɪf aɪ wɜː njˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you find much to change?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː fˈaɪnd mˈʌtʃ tə tʃˈeɪndʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mostly assumptions: names of tools, missing links and steps nobody had written down.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊstli ɐsˈʌmpʃənz nˈeɪmz ɒv tˈuːlz mˈɪsɪŋ lˈɪŋks and stˈɛps nˈəʊbɒdi had ɹˈɪtən dˈaʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Those are exactly the details experienced people stop noticing.
lines.ipa: /ðəʊz ɑːɹ ɛɡzˈaktli ðə dˈiːteɪlz ɛkspˈiəɹɪənst pˈiːpəl stˈɒp nˈəʊtɪsɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We negotiated a later deadline by showing what the earlier date would exclude.
lines.ipa: /wiː nɪɡˈəʊʃɪˌeɪtɪd ɐ lˈeɪtə dˈɛdlaɪn baɪ ʃˈəʊɪŋ wɒt ðɪ ˈɜːlɪə dˈeɪt wʊd ɛksklˈuːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So you brought a concrete choice rather than simply asking for more time.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ juː bɹˈɔːt ɐ kˈɒŋkɹiːt tʃˈɔɪs ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn sˈɪmpli ˈaskɪŋ fɔː mˈɔː tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. The client chose a complete delivery over a rushed partial one.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə klˈaɪənt tʃˈəʊz ɐ kəmplˈiːt dɪlˈɪvəɹi ˌəʊvəɹ ɐ ɹˈʌʃt pˈɑːʃəl wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Making the consequences visible gave them a real decision.
lines.ipa: /mˌeɪkɪŋ ðə kˈɒnsɪkwənsɪz vˈɪzɪbəl ɡˈeɪv ðˌɛm ɐ ɹˈiəl dɪsˈɪʒən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new colleague asked why we produce a report nobody seems to read.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː kˈɒliːɡ ˈaskt wˌaɪ wiː pɹədjˈuːs ɐ ɹɪpˈɔːt nˈəʊbɒdi sˈiːmz tə ɹˈiːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An awkward question for their first week.
lines.ipa: /ɐn ˈɔːkwəd kwˈɛstʃən fɔː ðeə fˈɜːst wˈiːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was also a good one. We discovered two teams were duplicating it.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wɒz ˈɔːlsəʊ ɐ ɡˈʊd wˌɒn wiː dɪskˈʌvəd tˈuː tˈiːmz wɜː djˈuːplɪkˌeɪtɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fresh eyes are useful when the team is willing to be mildly uncomfortable.
lines.ipa: /fɹˈɛʃ ˈaɪz ɑː jˈuːsfəl wɛn ðə tˈiːm ɪz wˈɪlɪŋ təbi mˈaɪldli ʌŋkˈʌmftəbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I apologised for interrupting, but not for disagreeing.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɐpˈɒlədʒˌaɪzd fɔːɹ ˌɪntəɹˈʌptɪŋ bˌʌt nˌɒt fɔː dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiːɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds like an important distinction.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈaʊndz lˈaɪk ɐn ɪmpˈɔːtənt dɪstˈɪŋkʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was. We could discuss the idea once we stopped arguing about my tone.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wˈɒz wiː kʊd dɪskˈʌs ðɪ aɪdˈiə wˈʌns wiː stˈɒpt ˈɑːɡjuːɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt maɪ tˈəʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You acknowledged the behaviour without withdrawing the point.
lines.ipa: /juː ɐknˈɒlɪdʒd ðə bɪhˈeɪvjə wɪðˌaʊt wɪθdɹˈɔːɪŋ ðə pˈɔɪnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The report now opens with the three decisions the reader needs to make.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt nˈaʊ ˈəʊpənz wɪððə θɹˈiː dɪsˈɪʒənz ðə ɹˈiːdə nˈiːdz tə mˈeɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Instead of a history of everything the team has done?
lines.ipa: /ɪnstˈɛd əvə hˈɪstəɹi ɒv ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ðə tˈiːm hɐz dˈʌn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. The detail is still there, but it no longer hides the purpose.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðə dˈiːteɪl ɪz stˈɪl ðˈeə bˌʌt ɪt nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡə hˈaɪdz ðə pˈɜːpəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That should make it easier to judge what matters.
lines.ipa: /ðat ʃˌʊd mˌeɪk ɪt ˈiːziə tə dʒˈʌdʒ wɒt mˈatəz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our workflow trial failed after two days, which was actually helpful.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə wˈɜːkfləʊ tɹˈaɪəl fˈeɪld ˈaftə tˈuː dˈeɪz wˌɪtʃ wɒz ˈaktʃuːəli hˈɛlpfəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because it exposed the problem before a full rollout?
lines.ipa: /bɪkˈɒz ɪt ɛkspˈəʊzd ðə pɹˈɒbləm bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐ fˈʊl ɹˈəʊlaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, and the people testing it explained exactly where the extra work appeared.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs and ðə pˈiːpəl tˈɛstɪŋ ɪt ɛksplˈeɪnd ɛɡzˈaktli wˌeə ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə wˈɜːk ɐpˈiəd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A small trial earns its value even when the proposal doesn't survive it.
lines.ipa: /ɐ smˈɔːl tɹˈaɪəl ˈɜːnz ɪts vˈaljuː ˈiːvən wɛn ðə pɹəpˈəʊzəl dˈʌzənt səvˈaɪv ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The handover went well because we discussed what hadn't worked.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈandəʊvə wɛnt wˈɛl bɪkˈɒz wiː dɪskˈʌst wɒt hˈadənt wˈɜːkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's often the part missing from the folder.
lines.ipa: /ðats ˈɒfən ðə pˈɑːt mˈɪsɪŋ fɹʌmðə fˈəʊldə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There were good reasons some obvious solutions had been rejected.
lines.ipa: /ðeəwˌɜː ɡˈʊd ɹˈiːzənz sˌʌm ˈɒbviəs səlˈuːʃənz hɐdbɪn ɹɪdʒˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You've inherited the reasoning, not just the current arrangement.
lines.ipa: /juːv ɪnhˈɛɹɪtɪd ðə ɹˈiːzənɪŋ nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ðə kˈʌɹənt ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our password manager trial ran into a problem nobody had considered.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə pˈaswɜːd mˈanɪdʒə tɹˈaɪəl ɹˈan ˌɪntʊ ɐ pɹˈɒbləm nˈəʊbɒdi had kənsˈɪdəd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What happens when someone loses access to the manager itself?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt hˈapənz wɛn sˈʌmwɒn lˈuːzɪz ˈaksɛs tə ðə mˈanɪdʒəɹ ɪtsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. We need an agreed recovery process as well as better passwords.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli wiː nˈiːd ɐn ɐɡɹˈiːd ɹɪkˈʌvəɹi pɹˈəʊsɛs az wˈɛl az bˈɛtə pˈaswɜːdz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Otherwise we've improved one part while leaving another entirely to chance.
lines.ipa: /ˈʌðəwˌaɪz wiːv ɪmpɹˈuːvd wˈɒn pˈɑːt wˌaɪl lˈiːvɪŋ ɐnˈʌðəɹ ɛntˈaɪəli tə tʃˈans/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I gave the client comment access rather than editing access.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɡˈeɪv ðə klˈaɪənt kˈɒmɛnt ˈaksɛs ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ˈɛdɪtɪŋ ˈaksɛs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did that slow down the review?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðat slˈəʊ dˌaʊn ðə ɹɪvjˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. It actually separated suggestions from approved changes much more clearly.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ɪt ˈaktʃuːəli sˈɛpəɹˌeɪtɪd sədʒˈɛstʃənz fɹɒm ɐpɹˈuːvd tʃˈeɪndʒɪz mˈʌtʃ mˈɔː klˈiəli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The smallest useful permission can also make collaboration easier to follow.
lines.ipa: /ðə smˈɔːlɪst jˈuːsfəl pəmˈɪʃən kan ˈɔːlsəʊ mˌeɪk kəlˌabəɹˈeɪʃən ˈiːziə tə fˈɒləʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We restored a random file from last month's backup and found it was unreadable.
lines.ipa: /wiː ɹɪstˈɔːd ɐ ɹˈandəm fˈaɪl fɹɒm lˈast mˈʌnθz bˈakʌp and fˈaʊnd ɪt wɒz ʌnɹˈiːdəbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the backup itself damaged?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə bˈakʌp ɪtsˈɛlf dˈamɪdʒd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The old software version couldn't open the newer format.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈəʊld sˈɒftweə vˈɜːʃən kˌʊdənt ˈəʊpən ðə njˈuːə fˈɔːmat/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a reminder to test usefulness, not just the existence of a copied file.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ ɹɪmˈaɪndə tə tˈɛst jˈuːsfəlnəs nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ðɪ ɛɡzˈɪstəns əvə kˈɒpɪd fˈaɪl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The team agreed that a phone call means urgent and chat means answer when available.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈiːm ɐɡɹˈiːd ðˌatə fˈəʊn kˈɔːl mˈiːnz ˈɜːdʒənt and tʃˈat mˈiːnz ˈansə wɛn ɐvˈeɪləbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has everyone kept to that?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn kˈɛpt tə ðˈat/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mostly. We also agreed on what urgent actually means.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊstli wiː ˈɔːlsəʊ ɐɡɹˈiːd ˌɒn wɒt ˈɜːdʒənt ˈaktʃuːəli mˈiːnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The rule works because the expectation is shared, not because notifications are clever.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈuːl wˈɜːks bɪkˈɒz ðɪ ɛkspɪktˈeɪʃən ɪz ʃˈeəd nˌɒt bɪkˈɒz nˌəʊtɪfɪkˈeɪʃənz ɑː klˈɛvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We postponed the update until we could test the feature our customers use most.
lines.ipa: /wiː pəʊstpˈəʊnd ðɪ ˈʌpdeɪt ʌntˈɪl wiː kʊd tˈɛst ðə fˈiːtʃəɹ ˌaʊə kˈʌstəməz jˈuːs mˈəʊst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the supplier pressure you to install immediately?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə səplˈaɪə pɹˈɛʃə juː tʊ ɪnstˈɔːl ɪmˈiːdɪətli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They did, but they also provided a test environment when we explained the risk.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ dˈɪd bˌʌt ðeɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ pɹəvˈaɪdɪd ɐ tˈɛst ɛnvˈaɪɹənmənt wɛn wiː ɛksplˈeɪnd ðə ɹˈɪsk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A clear reason is easier to discuss than a blanket refusal to change.
lines.ipa: /ɐ klˈiə ɹˈiːzən ɪz ˈiːziə tə dɪskˈʌs ðˌanə blˈaŋkɪt ɹɪfjˈuːzəl tə tʃˈeɪndʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The support agent asked me to describe what was working, not just what was broken.
lines.ipa: /ðə səpˈɔːt ˈeɪdʒənt ˈaskt mˌiː tə dɪskɹˈaɪb wɒt wɒz wˈɜːkɪŋ nˌɒt dʒˈʌst wɒt wɒz bɹˈəʊkən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did that help?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðat hˈɛlp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It ruled out the account and narrowed the fault to one device.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ɹˈuːld ˈaʊt ðɪ ɐkˈaʊnt and nˈaɹəʊd ðə fˈɒlt tə wˈɒn dɪvˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A good question can save several rounds of trying the same fix.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɡˈʊd kwˈɛstʃən kan sˈeɪv sˈɛvɹəl ɹˈaʊndz ɒv tɹˈaɪɪŋ ðə sˈeɪm fˈɪks/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The privacy notice became shorter after we separated essential information from optional detail.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹˈɪvəsi nˈəʊtɪs bɪkˌeɪm ʃˈɔːtəɹ ˈaftə wiː sˈɛpəɹˌeɪtɪd ɪsˈɛnʃəl ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən fɹɒm ˈɒpʃənəl dˈiːteɪl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did anything important disappear?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ɪmpˈɔːtənt dˌɪsɐpˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. We removed repetition and put specific choices beside the relevant features.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ wiː ɹɪmˈuːvd ɹˌɛpətˈɪʃən and pˌʊt spəsˈɪfɪk tʃˈɔɪsɪz bɪsˌaɪd ðə ɹˈɛlɪvənt fˈiːtʃəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Clarity doesn't require withholding information.
lines.ipa: /klˈaɹɪti dˈʌzənt ɹɪkwˈaɪə wɪðhˈəʊldɪŋ ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The accessibility review included someone completing the whole task using only a keyboard.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ aksˌɛsəbˈɪlɪti ɹɪvjˈuː ɪŋklˈuːdɪd sˈʌmwɒn kəmplˈiːtɪŋ ðə hˈəʊl tˈask jˈuːzɪŋ ˈəʊnli ɐ kˈiːbɔːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What did they find?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈɪd ðeɪ fˈaɪnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The page could be read, but the final confirmation button couldn't be reached.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈeɪdʒ kʊd biː ɹˈɛd bˌʌt ðə fˈaɪnəl kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən bˈʌtən kˌʊdənt biː ɹˈiːtʃt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Testing a page isn't the same as testing whether a person can finish.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛstɪŋ ɐ pˈeɪdʒ ˌɪzənt ðə sˈeɪm az tˈɛstɪŋ wˈɛðəɹ ɐ pˈɜːsən kan fˈɪnɪʃ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We used the AI tool to suggest questions, not to supply the evidence.
lines.ipa: /wiː jˈuːzd ðɪ ˌeɪˈaɪ tˈuːl tə sədʒˈɛst kwˈɛstʃənz nˌɒt tə səplˈaɪ ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why that distinction?
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ ðat dɪstˈɪŋkʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Its ideas helped us see gaps, but every factual claim still needed a source.
lines.ipa: /ɪts aɪdˈiəz hˈɛlpt ˌʌs sˈiː ɡˈaps bˌʌt ˈɛvɹɪ fˈaktʃuːəl klˈeɪm stˈɪl nˈiːdɪd ɐ sˈɔːs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That gives it a useful role without outsourcing the judgement.
lines.ipa: /ðat ɡˈɪvz ɪt ɐ jˈuːsfəl ɹˈəʊl wɪðˌaʊt aʊtsˈɔːsɪŋ ðə dʒˈʌdʒmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The service asked why I was leaving, but didn't make my answer compulsory.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɜːvɪs ˈaskt wˌaɪ aɪ wɒz lˈiːvɪŋ bˌʌt dˈɪdnt mˌeɪk maɪ ˈansə kəmpˈʌlsəɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That seems refreshingly straightforward.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈiːmz ɹɪfɹˈɛʃɪŋli stɹeɪtfˈɔːwəd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I gave detailed feedback because I wasn't being trapped into it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɡˈeɪv dˈiːteɪld fˈiːdbak bɪkˈɒz aɪ wˌɒzn̩t bˌiːɪŋ tɹˈapt ˌɪntʊ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: People may tell you more when they can genuinely choose to leave.
lines.ipa: /pˈiːpəl mˈeɪ tˈɛl juː mˈɔː wɛn ðeɪ kan dʒˈɛnjuːɪnli tʃˈuːz tə lˈiːv/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We ran a small test of the new recycling labels before printing them everywhere.
lines.ipa: /wiː ɹˈan ɐ smˈɔːl tˈɛst ɒvðə njˈuː ɹɪsˈaɪklɪŋ lˈeɪbəlz bɪfˌɔː pɹˈɪntɪŋ ðˌɛm ˈɛvɹɪwˌeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did people understand the symbols?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd pˈiːpəl ˌʌndəstˈand ðə sˈɪmbəlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One symbol meant food waste to some people and general rubbish to others.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn sˈɪmbəl mˈɛnt fˈuːd wˈeɪst tə sˌʌm pˈiːpəl and dʒˈɛnəɹəl ɹˈʌbɪʃ tʊ ˈʌðəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good thing the misunderstanding appeared in a test rather than across the whole district.
lines.ipa: /ɡˈʊd θˈɪŋ ðə mɪsˌʌndəstˈandɪŋ ɐpˈiəd ɪn ɐ tˈɛst ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn əkɹˌɒs ðə hˈəʊl dˈɪstɹɪkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The water-use display reports a building total, but nobody knows what counts as normal.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɔːtəjˈuːs dɪsplˈeɪ ɹɪpˈɔːts ɐ bˈɪldɪŋ tˈəʊtəl bˌʌt nˈəʊbɒdi nˈəʊz wɒt kˈaʊnts az nˈɔːməl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could it show a comparison with similar days?
lines.ipa: /kʊd ɪt ʃˈəʊ ɐ kəmpˈaɹɪsən wɪð sˈɪmɪlə dˈeɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, adjusted for how many people are using the building.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ɐdʒˈʌstɪd fɔː hˌaʊ mˈɛni pˈiːpəl ɑː jˈuːzɪŋ ðə bˈɪldɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Without context, a large number doesn't tell anyone what to change.
lines.ipa: /wɪðˌaʊt kˈɒntɛkst ɐ lˈɑːdʒ nˈʌmbə dˈʌzənt tˈɛl ˈɛnɪwˌɒn wɒt tə tʃˈeɪndʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The community decided to plant fewer trees than originally planned.
lines.ipa: /ðə kəmjˈuːnɪti dɪsˈaɪdɪd tə plˈant fjˈuːə tɹˈiːz ðɐn əɹˈɪdʒɪnəli plˈand/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was that a funding problem?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ðˌatə fˈʌndɪŋ pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Partly, but it left enough money for watering and replacement over the next few years.
lines.ipa: /pˈɑːtli bˌʌt ɪt lˈɛft ɪnˈʌf mˈʌni fɔː wˈɔːtəɹɪŋ and ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt ˌəʊvə ðə nˈɛkst fjˈuː jˈiəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A smaller planting that survives may achieve more than a larger photo opportunity.
lines.ipa: /ɐ smˈɔːlə plˈantɪŋ ðat səvˈaɪvz mˈeɪ ɐtʃˈiːv mˈɔː ðˌanə lˈɑːdʒə fˈəʊtəʊ ɒpətjˈuːnɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This year's park cleanup includes a briefing about what volunteers shouldn't handle.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs jˈiəz pˈɑːk klˈiːnʌp ɪŋklˈuːdz ɐ bɹˈiːfɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt wɒt vˌɒləntˈiəz ʃˌʊdənt hˈandəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was that missing before?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ðat mˈɪsɪŋ bɪfˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. People were trying to be helpful without knowing where to leave hazardous items.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs pˈiːpəl wɜː tɹˈaɪɪŋ təbi hˈɛlpfəl wɪðˌaʊt nˈəʊɪŋ wˌeə tə lˈiːv hˈazədəs ˈaɪtəmz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Clear limits protect volunteers as well as the place they're improving.
lines.ipa: /klˈiə lˈɪmɪts pɹətˈɛkt vˌɒləntˈiəz az wˈɛl az ðə plˈeɪs ðeɪəɹ ɪmpɹˈuːvɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The market reserved a few low-cost stalls for first-time sellers.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈɑːkɪt ɹɪzˈɜːvd ɐ fjˈuː lˈəʊkˈɒst stˈɔːlz fɔː fˈɜːsttˈaɪm sˈɛləz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did established sellers object?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ɪstˈablɪʃt sˈɛləz ˈɒbdʒɛkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Some did, until the organisers explained how limited the scheme would be.
lines.ipa: /sˌʌm dˈɪd ʌntˈɪl ðɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzəz ɛksplˈeɪnd hˌaʊ lˈɪmɪtɪd ðə skˈiːm wʊd bˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A targeted opportunity is easier to discuss when its purpose and boundaries are clear.
lines.ipa: /ɐ tˈɑːɡɪtɪd ɒpətjˈuːnɪti ɪz ˈiːziə tə dɪskˈʌs wɛn ɪts pˈɜːpəs and bˈaʊndəɹiz ɑː klˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tool library now records repair time alongside borrowing numbers.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈuːl lˈaɪbɹəɹi nˈaʊ ɹɪkˈɔːdz ɹɪpˈeə tˈaɪm ɐlˈɒŋsaɪd bˈɒɹəʊɪŋ nˈʌmbəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has that changed how people use it?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðat tʃˈeɪndʒd hˌaʊ pˈiːpəl jˈuːs ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Several regular borrowers offered to help once they saw the workload.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛvɹəl ɹˈɛɡjʊlə bˈɒɹəʊəz ˈɒfəd tə hˈɛlp wˈʌns ðeɪ sˈɔː ðə wˈɜːkləʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Visible maintenance can turn users into contributors.
lines.ipa: /vˈɪzɪbəl mˈeɪntənəns kan tˈɜːn jˈuːzəz ˌɪntʊ kəntɹˈɪbjuːtəz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The reusable-cup pilot reduced waste, but only after the return points were moved.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹiːjˈuːzəbəlkˈʌp pˈaɪlət ɹɪdjˈuːst wˈeɪst bˌʌt ˈəʊnli ˈaftə ðə ɹɪtˈɜːn pˈɔɪnts wɜː mˈuːvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Where had they been?
lines.ipa: /wˌeə hˈad ðeɪ bˌiːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Behind the counter, where returning a cup meant joining the queue again.
lines.ipa: /bɪhˌaɪnd ðə kˈaʊntə wˌeə ɹɪtˈɜːnɪŋ ɐ kˈʌp mˈɛnt dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ ðə kjˈuː ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The system was asking people to do the right thing in an unnecessarily awkward way.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɪstəm wɒz ˈaskɪŋ pˈiːpəl tə dˈuː ðə ɹˈaɪt θˈɪŋ ɪn ɐn ʌnnˌɛsɪsˈɛɹɪli ˈɔːkwəd wˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new cycle route was designed with people who don't currently cycle.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː sˈaɪkəl ɹˈuːt wɒz dɪzˈaɪnd wɪð pˈiːpəl hˌuː dˈəʊnt kˈʌɹəntli sˈaɪkəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why not just ask experienced cyclists?
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ˈask ɛkspˈiəɹɪənst sˈaɪklɪsts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They know the route already. We wanted to understand what keeps others away.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ nˈəʊ ðə ɹˈuːt ɔːlɹˈɛdi wiː wˈɒntɪd tʊ ˌʌndəstˈand wɒt kˈiːps ˈʌðəz ɐwˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That changes the question from improving a habit to making it possible.
lines.ipa: /ðat tʃˈeɪndʒɪz ðə kwˈɛstʃən fɹɒm ɪmpɹˈuːvɪŋ ɐ hˈabɪt tə mˌeɪkɪŋ ɪt pˈɒsɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The survey offered translated versions and an option to respond by phone.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɜːveɪ ˈɒfəd tɹanslˈeɪtɪd vˈɜːʃənz and ɐn ˈɒpʃən tə ɹɪspˈɒnd baɪ fˈəʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the extra effort change the findings?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðɪ ˈɛkstɹəɹ ˈɛfət tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə fˈaɪndɪŋz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We heard concerns that hadn't appeared in any of the online comments.
lines.ipa: /wiː hˈɜːd kənsˈɜːnz ðat hˈadənt ɐpˈiəd ɪn ˌɛni ɒvðɪ ˈɒnlaɪn kˈɒmɛnts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A wider range of methods can reveal a wider range of needs.
lines.ipa: /ɐ wˈaɪdə ɹˈeɪndʒ ɒv mˈɛθədz kan ɹɪvˈiːl ɐ wˈaɪdə ɹˈeɪndʒ ɒv nˈiːdz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The budget meeting published the rejected proposals as well as the successful ones.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈʌdʒɪt mˈiːtɪŋ pˈʌblɪʃt ðə ɹɪdʒˈɛktɪd pɹəpˈəʊzəlz az wˈɛl az ðə səksˈɛsfəl wˌɒnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With reasons for each decision?
lines.ipa: /wɪð ɹˈiːzənz fɔːɹ ˈiːtʃ dɪsˈɪʒən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, including where two projects were combined.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ɪŋklˈuːdɪŋ wˌeə tˈuː pɹˈɒdʒɛkts wɜː kəmbˈaɪnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That makes the process easier to understand than a cheerful announcement of the winners.
lines.ipa: /ðat mˌeɪks ðə pɹˈəʊsɛs ˈiːziə tʊ ˌʌndəstˈand ðˌanə tʃˈiəfəl ɐnˈaʊnsmənt ɒvðə wˈɪnəz/
